Origin and meaning

Shane is an Irish name meaning “God is gracious (form of John)”.

About the name Shane

An anglicised Irish form of John, made famous by the western novel Shane.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Shane carries the meaning “God is gracious (form of John)” and looks striking in brush strokes.
